_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
Nang {player_id} u ga, {num_players} u ga shani LiarsDice galaw ga na.
Hpungdan:
- Nang shani hta, nang gaw:
  1) Shawng hte masum hkrat hte, shawng hte myit hkrat hte galaw ga, '[Bid: 3, 4]' ngu ai,
  2) '[Call]' ngu ai.

Nang '[Call]' ngu ai shaloi:
  - Si htum shawng hte myit hkrat hte shawng hte galaw ga, shawng hte masum shawng hte hkrat hte wa u ga si htum shawng hte masum shawng gaw e.
  - Shawng hte, u wa u ga si htum shawng hte masum shawng gaw e.
Si htum shawng hte masum shawng hte hkrat hte wa u ga galaw ga, shawng hte wa u ga shanhte e. Shawng hte wa u ga shani shawng hte shanhte e.

board.new_round:
New round - Remaining dice: {dice_summary}
Nang ai hpe dice {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Masha {current_player_id} kawp na shang ai! {face_value} ngut ai {count} hte {quantity} kaw na shang lawu ai.
Masha {loser_id} (shanhte bidder wa) sai hte lakung hkrum ai.
call.caller_loses:
{current_player_id} wa u ga u! {face_value} myit hte {count} shawng hte {quantity} hte shawng hta e.
{loser_id} u ga (u wa u ga) si htum shawng hte masum shawng gaw e.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: Kawp na shang ai hte bid shi ai.
invalid_move.not_recognized: Kunglawp na re ai '[Bid: X, Y]' shi '[Call]' kawp na re ai. Kunglawp sha {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: {new_quantity} hte {current_quantity} kaw na shang lawu ai.
bid_reason.face_lower: {new_face_value} hte {current_face_value} kaw na shang lawu ai.
bid_reason.identical: Bid hte shanhte bid kawp na re ai.
bid_reason.face_range: Nsen manu gaw 1 hte 6 lapran rai ra ai.

message.eliminated_invalid: Player {player_id} gaw n htuk ai shamu shamawt lam hte pru mat wa sai.

outcome.win: Shi kaw mi {winner} kaw shi kaw mi hta taw kaw shi taw kaw hta! Shi kaw mi hta taw kaw shi taw kaw hta kaw hti kaw kaw {final_ranking}
